title: Gandhian philosophy: more quotes and ideas

boxes.title: More quotations
head: Quote
Point
rows: "My religion is based on truth and non-violence. **Truth is my God**"
"Real Swaraj will come... by the **capacity of all to resist authority when abused**"
"**Poverty is the worst form of violence**"
"Non-violence is not a **garment** to be put on and off at will"

boxes.title: Ideas: added detail
items: Satyagraha in English: "**passive resistance**"; soul force in place of ==**physical force**==
Non-violence of the **brave** vs of the **weak**
Swaraj also = capacity of **masses to govern themselves without coercion**
Swaraj: ==**eight interrelated principles**==, incl. **swadeshi**, ahimsa, satyagraha, decentralisation, **education for all**
